Osmium Sound

Official self-hosted F-Droid repository for Osmium Sound Companion, the Android remote control app for the Osmium Sound hi-fi appliance (https://github.com/adri6412/osmium-sound).

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://adri6412.github.io/osmium-companion-android/fdroid/repo
